items.title: Lee Collins Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, you're going to the band that you played with there in France... Is that Claude Luther or which band? [INTERVIEWEE] Well, we played with French men.

ctx.x: Well, you're going to the band that you played with there in France, with men, the musicians in the band. Is that Claude Luther or which band?
